summary: This is a patient medical record — specifically a Nuclear Medicine Brain Cisternogram radiology report from MyChart (Epic Systems). It documents a clinical diagnostic imaging study performed on an individual patient to evaluate for a CSF (cerebrospinal fluid) leak. The report concludes with no evidence of leakage. This is a personal health record, not a biotech/science project or R&D document, and contains no information relevant to TRL assessment.

content_blocks.title: NM Brain Cisternogram – Full Report
content_blocks.content: EXAM: NM BRAIN CISTERNOGRAM. CLINICAL INDICATION: CSF leak. TECHNIQUE: 0.5 mCi indium-111 DTPA administered intrathecally via lumbar puncture. Multiple planar images obtained immediately post-administration and up to 96 hours post-injection, including views of the calvarium, lumbar, and thoracic spine. SPECT-CT of the head obtained at 24, 48, and 72 hours. COMPARISON: CT 10/10/2021. FINDINGS: Physiologic distribution of radiopharmaceutical. No evidence for leakage. IMPRESSION: No evidence for leak. Final result by Anthony Yudd MD, dictated 4/17/2023 10:28 AM.
